_note: Area rails, ported from the retired RobOS user-level layer 2026-07-29 (workshop#24). This is the one Area with a live public surface, so its irreversible mistakes are real: a bad deploy is seen by families, and generated files hand-edited here are silently overwritten on the next build.

hooks.command: jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.command // "") | test("next dev|run dev|yarn dev|pnpm dev|bun dev")) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",additionalContext:"DEV-SERVER: Rob reviews on the LIVE site by default. Ask before starting a dev server - confirm he wants localhost for this back-and-forth rather than a prod deploy. Once he has said yes, start it and give him the URL. Never start one unprompted just to show him a change; deploy to prod for that. Also: a preview deploy FAILS here (env vars are Production-scoped), so do not chase the code when vercel without --prod exits 1."}} else empty end'

jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.file_path // "") | test("content/[^/]*[.]json$|public/calendar[.]ics$|public/calendar-data[.]json$")) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",additionalContext:"GENERATED FILE - do not hand-edit. Page content is built from content/sources/*.md via npm run content:build. Calendar output is rendered from the events store. Editing the artifact means the next build silently reverts you. Edit the SOURCE and rebuild. See this repo CLAUDE.md."}} else empty end'
